title: The Best Automatic Litter Box of 2026: Petkit and Litter-Robot
summary: With these high-tech automatic litter boxes, gone are the days of scooping and smells. Welcome to the future.
llm_summary: The 2026 roundup of automatic litter boxes crowns Petkit and the Litter‑Robot as the top performers, thanks to their smart sensors, self‑cleaning cycles, and odor‑control systems. These high‑tech units eliminate the need for daily scooping and keep homes fresher, showcasing how pet care is becoming as sophisticated as any other smart‑home appliance.
